name: GFM Heading Slugs
tip: Run the command "Copy GitHub-style link to the current heading" to get a link that works in Obsidian and on GitHub.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. GFM Heading Slugs is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
